subject: Runtime headcount prioritization: seniority mix & conversion request
messages:
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: TalentOps <talentops@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Runtime headcount prioritization: seniority mix & conversion request

Team —

TL;DR: Requesting approval to reallocate two approved senior runtime slots (FY26 tranche A) into one senior + one mid-senior slot, and to convert contractor R. Gomez (runtime reliability contractor) to a perm IC at L4 with a 6-month ramp guardrail. Finance impact included in attached cost model.

Context: We have three open senior runtime slots earmarked for kernel/serving work. After interviewing and workload analysis, Marcus and I recommend adjusting the mix to better cover the breadth of upcoming infra work (distributed KV cache, compilation pipeline, and on-call rotation). The team is suffering a seniority mismatch: too many seniors concentrated in kernel-only work and a gap in mid-level ownership for feature scope.

Proposal (asks):
- Reallocate 2x senior FTEs -> 1x senior (L5) + 1x mid-senior (L4.5).
- Convert contractor Ramon Gomez -> perm (L4) on a 6-month performance check with a defined ramp plan.
- Approve comp-band flexibility up to +7% on midpoint for the L4 hire to retain candidate pipeline.

Why now: We have an inbound production partner (EdgeCloud) onboarding in Q1 with low-latency SLOs; this requires quicker delivery across both kernel optimizations and runtime reliability workstreams. Delaying risks ramp slippage and overtime.

Files attached: cost_model_v2.xlsx (delta vs current plan), jd_runtime_sre.pdf, comp-band-comparison.csv.

Ask: Please reply with decision or questions by EOD today so TalentOps can act on offers next week.

Thanks —
Maya
Maya Srinivasan
Director, Runtime Platforms
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Runtime headcount prioritization: seniority mix & conversion request

Maya —

I support the proposed split. Quick technical notes to justify:
- The mid-senior slot (L4.5) will own release orchestration and KV cache correctness work; that will unblock two senior engineers to focus purely on compilation and low-level kernels for the next 6 months.
- Ramon has been on the team for 11 months and already owns the critical incident postmortem flow and a portion of the on-call rotation. His ramp to perm would be low-risk if we attach two deliverables (one infra automation, one RCA-led reliability improvement) to the 6-month review.

Alternative if exec wants conservative spend: stagger hiring over two quarters (L5 this quarter, L4.5 in Q1). That reduces near-term cost but increases risk to EdgeCloud timeline.

No redlines from me — recommend approve with the 6-month ramp guardrail.

- Marcus
Senior Engineering Manager, Platform
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, TalentOps <talentops@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T11:24:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Runtime headcount prioritization: seniority mix & conversion request

Thanks for the clear ask. A few finance points before I can sign off:

1) Cost delta: The attached cost_model_v2.xlsx shows a one-time hiring/onboarding delta of ~$18k and an ongoing run-rate increase of ~$42k/year if we convert Ramon versus hiring a full L4.5 externally (because of contractor conversion premium). Please confirm the assumptions tab is accurate (I flagged a candidate comp assumption).

2) Comp band flexibility: +7% is doable but requires VP approval if comp would exceed range midpoint by >10% once offer terms (sign-on, equity) are fully assembled. Please have TalentOps prepare an offer band summary and comp rationale.

3) Headcount accounting: If we convert Ramon this fiscal quarter, confirm which headcount bucket to debit (Runtime Ops vs Kernel squad). This affects next quarter's capacity planning.

If the team is confident on timeline risk to EdgeCloud, I can provisionally approve the reallocation and conversion pending updated numbers from TalentOps and sign-off from Karthik on comp exceptions.

Kimberly
VP Finance, Infrastructure
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, TalentOps <talentops@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T13:05:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Runtime headcount prioritization: seniority mix & conversion request

Karthik —

Forwarding Maya's ask and the finance notes from Kimberly. Short ask: Can you approve the comp-band flexibility (up to +7% midpoint) and the conversion of Ramon to perm at L4 with the 6-month performance guardrail?

If you prefer, we can route a formal comp-exception request through VP approvals, but the team needs clarity today to proceed with offers.

Attachment highlights: cost_model_v2.xlsx (sensitivity), comp-band-comparison.csv.

Cheers,
Marissa
Head of Platform Operations
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, TalentOps <talentops@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T15:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Runtime headcount prioritization: seniority mix & conversion request

Marissa / team —

Thanks for the concise package. Approve the proposed reallocation (2 senior -> 1 senior + 1 mid-senior) and the contractor conversion of Ramon Gomez to L4 on the 6-month performance check with the two deliverables Marcus listed. I also sign off on up to +7% comp band flexibility for the L4 hire; if final cash + equity would push comp beyond midpoint by more than 10%, loop me back before offer is accepted.

Operational notes:
- TalentOps: please tag the hire to Runtime Ops for headcount debits.
- Finance: Kimberly, we'll treat the conversion as a headcount movement this quarter — if cost materially differs from the model, send me a short note for rebalancing.

Please proceed with offers. Keep me posted if EdgeCloud timing shifts.

Karthik
VP, Product & Platform Strategy
Redwood Inference
